name: PlanSwift
summary: Desktop takeoff and estimating with drag-and-drop item building, now sold by ConstructConnect.
differentiator: Trade plug-ins for roofing, concrete, earthwork and electrical are separate costs on top of the reported $2,000 per year Professional subscription. Third-party sources report that ConstructConnect ended perpetual licenses in 2025 and moved existing users to annual subscriptions, so anyone who owned PlanSwift outright should check what renewal now costs.
pricing: Third-party sources report a Professional subscription at $2,000 per year including updates, support and two hours of training, with trade plug-ins extra. Not confirmed on the vendor page.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per user per year
bestFor: Trade subs who build their own assemblies and want desktop speed.
skipIf: You want browser-based collaboration across estimators.
